exposure: Cesarean section delivery in the same operation room
cohort: Three neonates referred from an obstetrics clinic who presented with invasive SGSP infections within a 2-month period.
finding: A cluster of invasive Streptococcus gallolyticus subspecies pasteurianus infections in three neonates, linked to a single bacterial clone, suggested a possible outbreak originating from a shared operation room.
mod_finding: All three neonates were delivered through cesarean section in the same operation room, indicating a potential common source of infection related to the mode and location of birth.
followup_time: At least 14 days (duration of antibiotic treatment)
